name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 19 - Am 47
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 19a. Calls for the next EU budget to include an increase in the allocations intended for public investment in transport infrastructure and for the promotion of public transport and sustainable mobility; calls for account to be taken of the urgent need for support for local and regional transport infrastructure in the Member States, and not only for transnational connections, with a particular focus on rail infrastructure; is opposed to the use of the EU budget to strengthen public-private partnerships, to further privatisation or to open up the transport sector;
